Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the property taxation and valuation of standing trees within urban growth area boundaries.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the property taxation and valuation of standingtrees within urban growth area boundaries; and adding a new section tochapter 84.36 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any standing tree on real property located in an urban growtharea boundary is exempt from property taxation, if the taxpayerprovided the county assessor documentation on the value of the tree ortrees as required in subsection (2) of this section. (2) The value of any standing tree or trees must be determined bya certified arborist at the election of, and cost to, the taxpayer. (3) If the taxpayer elects to provide documentation, as provided insubsection (2) of this section, on the value of any standing tree ortrees on the property to the county assessor, the county assessor mustinclude the exempt value of the standing tree or trees as part of theappraisal and the assessor must continue to reduce the value of the p. 1 SB 5521real property within an urban growth area boundary consistent with theexempt value of any standing trees on the property.
